title: Simple Visualisation
text:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
%matplotlib inline
%config InlineBackend.figure_format = 'retina'


x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
y = np.sin(x)

plt.plot(x, y)









import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({'x':x,'y':y})

df.plot(x='x',y='y')
